verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Here I am waiting, abide in me I pray
Here I am longing for You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Hide me in Your Love,
Bring me to my knees
May I know Jesus more and more

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Come live in me, all my life
Take over
Come breathe in me, and I will rise
On Eagle's Wings
